note: Category holds only the tried file, a Siza design-museum photo and an exhibition shot; searches (English, Chinese, Buildings by Wang Shu) found only metro-station exits. No free photo of Wang Shu campus buildings on Commons.

Micha L. Rieser photos (4288x2848), licence is the Commons {{Attribution}} template (free, credit only; file EXIF also says CC BY-SA 4.0). Bild 2 and 5 are full corner views of the stacked truss building; Bild 4 is a close-up of the external stairs and trusses.

note: Both 1280x720, the only photos of the building. First: elevated frontal view of the sandstone facade with the Hodgkin banyan mural (small crowd at the door, building fills the frame). Second: night aerial with festival projections on the facade, secondary only.

Exterior (1200x1600) is the best outside view on Commons: the white pavilion with its Coppelia sign behind palms, though blue tents in front hide part of the base. Coppelia2 shows the upper-level interior with the spiral ramp and ribbed concrete ceiling; Coppelia3 the stained-glass screen. No clear unobstructed exterior exists.

Only clear image of El-Wakil's mosque is File:مسجد الكورنيش - جدة.jpg, 530x590 and apparently a book/magazine scan (too small, licence doubtful). Other Jeddah Corniche mosque photos on Commons are different buildings (Al-Rahma floating mosque, King Fahd mosque, Hassan Anani mosque).

01 (3280x2460) is a close three-quarter view of the red undulating shell on its arches, with students around it. 4 is a wider view across the plaza showing the whole profile; 3 shows the underside, stair and arch.

No full-elevation close view exists; best exterior is 48559383232, the upper part of the translucent polycarbonate twin with its rooftop text, clearly the building. Then the restored AP2 hall facade (48564293071), the AP2 hall interior with installations (48564432777), and the new building's glazed circulation (FRAC (10)). Beach views from Malo-les-Bains are too distant.

Commons has only the four tried files plus an infinity-pool view (Sri Lanka,Heritance Ahungalla.jpg) and a beach view, neither showing the building. No category; searches for Triton Hotel and Heritance Bawa found nothing else.
Category:Anaheim Ice holds only the tried file; searches for Anaheim Ice, Disney Ice and the rink find nothing else of the Gehry building.

Roissy aérogard 1 (5881x3984): the round concrete drum on its Y-piers with access ramps. 2018a: closer view of the drum. Terminal1 CDGParisAirport: aerial of the drum and its seven satellites. 9048352355: the interior escalator tubes crossing the central well.

Only clear free view is File:Théoule-sur-Mer-Miramar, Le Paleis Bulles - panoramio.jpg (CC BY 3.0, seen: the bubble house on the hillside, clearly shown) but it is only 676x507, under the 800px floor. Use it only if a small image is acceptable. 064 La pointe de l'Esquillon is a distant coastline view.
